title: Being an open immersion descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02L3)
statement: Let $\varphi:Y\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{h_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For every $i\in I$ let $(Y_i,p_i,\varphi_i)$ be a fibre product of $\varphi$ and $h_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with $p_i:Y_i\to Y$, $\varphi_i:Y_i\to T_i$ and $\varphi\circ p_i=h_i\circ\varphi_i$. If $\varphi_i$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] for every $i\in I$, then $\varphi$ is an open immersion.

proof.text: For the property of being an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], Mathlib supplies Zariski locality at the target and stability under arbitrary base change. Its proved instance descendsAlong_isOpenImmersion_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasicompact' (the declaration recorded by [lem-galois-open-immersion-affine-descent], in its full generality) supplies descent along surjective flat quasi-compact morphisms. These are exactly the typeclass assumptions of the source library covering-family descent theorem.

The given fpqc precover [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] generates an fpqc covering sieve by Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck. Apply the proved source declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc) with P = IsOpenImmersion, the given maps p and phi', the given fibre-product witnesses [def-pc-fibre-product], and the hypotheses that phi' i are open immersions. It yields IsOpenImmersion phi directly, with arbitrary index universe and no choice of canonical pullbacks. This invokes proved covering-family descent rather than the unfinished Sheaf formulation of the affine fpqc-local criterion.
